activity_summary: Outside, Henslowe said the count stayed at the door and that your penny was the end of your business with it. Alleyn was cordial and brief. He was glad you had come. You said the play played, and that you were glad you had come. You did not ask what the door had taken. You did not stay.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Thanked him briefly and did not ask the takings.

entities.name: Edward Alleyn
entities.context: Said he was glad of the visit, and let him go.

entities.name: Philip Henslowe
entities.context: Kept the count at the door.

facets.activity: Heard Alleyn's cordial word and set Henslowe's count aside

quotes.speaker: philip_henslowe
quotes.text: The count stays at the door.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It plays. I am glad I came.
